title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching, quant profiles, and unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost for common workloads by providing safe, tested defaults and tooling that ties optimization decisions to unit economics. This PR wires together three pieces: 1) autotuned defaults for batching and KV/prefix caching that are conservative by default but adapt per-model and traffic patterns; 2) model quantization profile definitions and a small runtime loader that enables safe A/B rollouts of lower-precision variants; 3) unit-economics tooling (collector + dashboard + export) to make the impact of changes visible to product and infra owners.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds an autotune service that computes recommended batching/caching defaults based on historical latency/p95, input length distribution, and model kernel profiles. Recommendations are surfaced via the API and stored as candidate defaults.
- Ships runtime integration so worker pools can opt into `autotune_defaults: true` in their config; this enables gradual rollout per-deployment.
- Introduces quantization profile metadata (profiles/*.yaml) and a lightweight loader (runtime/quant/profiles.go) to map workloads -> recommended precision (fp16/int8/llm-int8). Profiles include safety gates (accuracy regression thresholds) and fallback rules.
- Implements unit-econ collector that correlates token-cost, batching efficiency, cache hit-rate, and tail latency into a daily report. Exposes a Prometheus-compatible exporter and a new small React dashboard (UnitEconDashboard) behind feature flag `unit_econ_ui`.
- Adds migration and rollout docs (docs/cost-optimization.md) and a checklist for SREs to enable autotune in Dedicated clusters.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add autotune service + storage + API surface
- [x] Runtime worker opt-in + safe defaults
- [x] Quantization profile format and loader
- [x] Unit economics collector + exporter + UI (feature-flagged)
- [x] Tests for core heuristics and integration smoke tests
- [x] Docs and runbook entries

Risks and mitigations:
- Accuracy regressions from quantization: profiles include a per-model quality check and automatic fallback to higher precision if regression > threshold. We also exposed an operator override.
- Latency regressions from aggressive batching: autotune defaults are conservative and include per-route maximum latency SLO constraints. Operators can pin batch sizes per-route.
- Telemetry gaps: collector instrumentation added to core token path and batching controller; if exporter is disabled we fall back to internal logs and a nightly job that emits diagnostics.

Related Linear/JIRA: ENG-4721 (autotune core), ENG-4783 (quant profiles), PM-311 (unit-econ product scope), SUP-2101 (customer request for cost transparency).

ci_timeline: Initial CI run (2024-11-06) failed on unit tests (autotune heuristics) -> fixed in commit e5f7a90 -> rerun CI (2024-11-07) all green -> integration matrix caught a quant edge case -> added guard in profiles.go -> final CI green (2024-11-11).
testing_notes: Includes unit tests for heuristics, integration smoke that spins up a single worker pool with sample traffic shapes, e2e run that exercises feature flag gating for unit_econ_ui. Also added a fuzz test for quant loader to catch malformed profile files.
migration_notes: Operators should: 1) review recommended defaults in /internal/autotune/recommendations; 2) enable 'autotune_defaults: true' on a canary pool; 3) monitor unit-econ dashboard for cost and latency deltas for 48h before enabling cluster-wide. See docs/cost-optimization.md for step-by-step runbook.
release_notes: Add conservative autotune defaults for batching/caching, introduce quantization profile loading for safe precision rollouts, and provide unit-economics telemetry and optional dashboard. Feature-flag 'unit_econ_ui' and opt-in worker config 'autotune_defaults'.
post_merge_actions: Backfill historical metrics for first 30 days into unit-econ collector (cron job scheduled). Notify SRE and key customers in #prod-inference before enabling autotune in Dedicated clusters.
notes_for_release_manager: This is non-breaking. Recommend staging rollout by region and pinning a single canary cluster. Coordinate with Observability to ensure retention of new unit-econ metrics for 90 days.
short_summary: Implements autotune defaults for batching/caching, quantization profiles with safe fallback, and unit-economics tooling to measure cost impact. Merged to main via squash.
